assumptions.description: Task c5_j fixes 2000 rows and ordered columns subject_id, x1, x2, x3 with units u1/u2/u3. This is a separate whole-cohort realization, not an extension of particular parent rows.
Bookkeeping choice: deterministic IDs C5-J-000001 through C5-J-002000, independent of seed and sampled values. IDs label synthetic rows; repeated seeds/runs do not create patients.

Computational choice: PCG64 initialized only with the controller-supplied seed; independent standard-normal triples transformed by a Cholesky covariance factor. No sample-moment correction, truncation, row rejection, seed search or evidence-parameter uncertainty is added.

n_rows.derivation: Task-defined output count, not source sample size.

units.derivation: Reported arbitrary units retained without conversion.

distribution.derivation: Full joint multivariate normal family is explicitly reported.

mean_vector.derivation: Reported exact means (12,-7,40) in variable order.

covariance_matrix.derivation: Derived: each variance is squared reported SD; Cov12=0.45*3*5=6.75; Cov13=-0.25*3*8=-6; Cov23=0.35*5*8=14. Leading principal minors are 9, 2871/16 and 7686, all positive.

identifier.derivation: Task identifier column plus explicit prefix, padding and one-based row index.

random_generator.derivation: Explicit PRNG choice. Seed is supplied externally and never fitted.

source_version.derivation: Select the admitted final packet only; SHA256 binds the supplied registry artifact.
